C1803.title: 17-Year-Old Sentenced to Four Years for DDoS Attack on Airline Ticketing System After Failing to Buy Ticket
keywords: 17-year-old sentenced for DDoS attack on ticketing system after failing to buy ticket
crime of damaging computer information systems
C1803.summary: In June 2020, a 17-year-old named Xiao Chen launched a DDoS attack on an airline's ticketing system after failing to buy a ticket home during the pandemic, causing a 4-hour outage affecting 50 million users. In August 2021, the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court announced the ruling: the Guangzhou Baiyun District Court sentenced Xiao Chen to four years in prison for the crime of damaging computer information systems.
